module tri_oracle_guard182_observer;
  integer ticks=0;
  integer previous_completed=-1;
  initial begin
    forever begin
      #10000;
      ticks++;
      if (ticks <=20 || $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.completed != previous_completed) begin
      $display("GUARD182_TIME time=%0t cycle=%0d completed=%0d seen=%0d", $time,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.cycle,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.completed,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.seen);
      $fflush();
      end
      previous_completed=$root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.completed;
    end
  end
  always @(negedge $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.clk)
    if ($root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.out_valid) begin
      $display("GUARD182_OUTPUT time=%0t ready=%b last=%b count=%0d", $time,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.out_ready,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.out_last,
        $root.tri_oracle_predicted_feedforward_frame_tb.out_count);
      $fflush();
    end
endmodule
